name: Residential Unit Generator
description: Generate and rank apartment plan variants from the residential-unit-generator prototype.

outputParameters.name: top_result
outputParameters.description: Best-ranked unit result as JSON string.

outputParameters.name: summary_path
outputParameters.description: Path to the written summary CSV.

outputParameters.name: geometry
outputParameters.description: JSON geometry payload for batch results.

outputParameters.name: rooms
outputParameters.description: Room polygon outlines for the top result.

outputParameters.name: walls
outputParameters.description: Wall segments for the top result.

outputParameters.name: labels
outputParameters.description: Room labels for the top result.

outputParameters.name: doors
outputParameters.description: Door point locations for the top result.

outputParameters.name: points
outputParameters.description: Room point cloud for the top result.

outputParameters.name: rhino_objects
outputParameters.description: Rhino geometry objects for the top result when available; otherwise pure-Python fallback.

outputParameters.name: extra_payload
outputParameters.description: Extra Rhino-oriented output payloads for layers, texts, and groups.

outputParameters.name: write_status
outputParameters.description: Status of writing the top result into the active Rhino document.
